name: Jeju (kids, snow & Japanese food)
notes: Land 09:30 Sun 27 Dec, fly 19:50 Wed 30 Dec (international from Singapore). One outing a day in the morning, afternoons for naps. Outing A (snow, 1100 Altitude Wetland) is on day 2 and outing B (Hello Kitty Island + Camellia Hill, indoor) is on day 3: swap them if the forecast says so. Snow is a bonus, not the plan; the 1100 and 5.16 roads can close. No Pokemon event is confirmed for these dates: check 9.81 Park around 1 Dec and skip it unless the Pokemon package is confirmed. No child seats in regular taxis: pre-book transfers/charter with a seat. Base: Jeju City (Nohyeong/Shinjeju). K-ETA exemption for Singapore passports runs to 31 Dec 2026. Source doc: Jeju Trip 27-30 Dec 2026 (Claude Docs).

stops.title: Land at Jeju Airport; immigration and bags
stops.notes: Fill in the e-Arrival Card beforehand. Buy a T-money card at the airport CU or 7-Eleven.

stops.title: Private transfer to Jeju City with child seat
stops.notes: Regular taxis rarely carry a child seat. Airport bus 100 or 500 is the cheap option (about 30 min) but awkward with bags and a toddler.

stops.title: Lunch at Uratchacha sushibu (conveyor-belt sushi)
stops.notes: 11:30-21:30, closed 15:00-17:00. Listed as family-friendly. Backup: Mikadosushi, City Hall.

stops.title: Check in (or drop bags); toddler nap
stops.notes: Ask for early check-in. Hotel still to choose.

stops.title: Nap and rest at hotel
Early dinner at Yunok Nohyeong (ramen)
stops.notes: 11:30-20:00; lines at meal times. Backup: Jeongjikhan Sushi (not verified, confirm it is open).

stops.title: Back to hotel; early night

days.title: Outing A: snow morning (swap with day 3 if the forecast says so)

stops.title: Breakfast at hotel or nearby cafe
Drive up the 1100 road with the snow-day driver (child seat)
stops.notes: Check road status on the Jeju Traffic Information Center first. Roads can close and cars may need chains. If closed, switch to outing B.

stops.title: 1100 Altitude Wetland: flat 675 m boardwalk in the snow
stops.notes: Free, free parking (small lot). Sits at 1,100 m, 6-7 C colder than Jeju City. Best on a clear day 10:00-16:00 after a cold spell. Warm hat, gloves, windproof layer.

stops.title: Sit-down sledding on the natural slope on the way
stops.notes: Sleds for rent at a stand beside the slope, about 5,000 KRW.

stops.title: Drive back to Jeju City
Lunch at Susuram (tonkatsu, donburi, karaage)
stops.notes: Near Jeju City Hall. Not verified: confirm hours and that it is open. Mini karaage on the menu.

stops.title: Nap and rest at hotel
Dinner at Mikadosushi, City Hall (conveyor-belt sushi)
stops.notes: 11:30-21:30, closed 15:00-17:00. 70+ items; arrive early for the dinner rush.

days.title: Outing B: Hello Kitty Island and Camellia Hill (indoor, rain-proof)

stops.title: Breakfast at hotel or nearby cafe
Drive to Andeok (southwest) with child seat
stops.notes: Use the pre-booked driver or charter. Hello Kitty Island and Camellia Hill are close together.

stops.title: Hello Kitty Island
stops.notes: Indoor, three floors plus rooftop garden and arcade. 09:00-18:00, last entry 17:00 (one reseller lists 09:00-17:00 on weekdays, so confirm). Don't pair with Snoopy Garden: kids tire of similar character parks.

stops.title: Camellia Hill (camellias in bloom)
stops.notes: 08:30-17:00 in Dec-Feb. Outdoor garden; short stroll.

stops.title: Lunch at Su Udon (Aewol/Hallim)
stops.notes: Not verified: confirm hours. Fodor's also lists an udon and tonkatsu place near Hyeopjae Beach.

stops.title: Drive back to Jeju City
Nap and rest at hotel
Dinner at Cedars Sushi, Yeondong (sushi set course)
stops.notes: Not verified: confirm hours. Set course suits mixed appetites. Backup: Jeongjikhan Sushi (about US$13 per set; ask for half the rice).

stops.title: Back to hotel; pack
Breakfast at hotel (try abalone porridge if offered)
Check out; leave bags with the hotel
Eco Land train ride through Gotjawal forest (or Dongmun Market stroll for a lighter option)
stops.notes: Trains 08:40-16:30 in Dec-Mar; dress warmly. Dongmun Traditional Market in Jeju City is the usual place for local snacks and tangerines.

stops.title: Lunch at Udon Kaden (near Eco Land)
Back to hotel; rest and collect bags
Private transfer to Jeju Airport with child seat
stops.notes: Keep this day light on purpose: snow and wind cancelled 163 of 461 Jeju flights on 8 Feb 2026.

stops.title: Check in, security, immigration
Flight from Jeju to Singapore

bookings.notes: Enter carrier, reference, seats and cost.

bookings.title: Hotel Jeju City (3 nights, 27-30 Dec)
bookings.notes: Not chosen yet: Jeju City (Nohyeong/Shinjeju) for the airport and restaurants, or near Jungmun for a warmer, clearer south side.

bookings.title: Airport transfer with child seat (arrival and return)
bookings.notes: One listing shows a baby car seat add-on of 20,000 KRW; confirm when booking. Return pickup 16:30 on 30 Dec.

bookings.title: Snow-day charter with child seat (28 Dec)
bookings.notes: Private driver or 8-hour charter; add the child seat when booking. One tour listing says it provides none.

bookings.title: Hello Kitty Island tickets (29 Dec)
bookings.notes: Optional pre-booking via a reseller such as Trazy; confirm hours.

checklist.text: Confirm flights: arrive Jeju 09:30 on 27 Dec, depart 19:50 on 30 Dec
Choose and book the hotel (Jeju City vs near Jungmun)
Book airport transfers with a child seat (arrival and 16:30 return)
Book the snow-day driver or charter with a child seat
Confirm the K-ETA exemption for Singapore passports covers 27-30 Dec
Fill in the Korea e-Arrival Card (check how early it opens)
Check 9.81 Park for a Pokemon package (Naver blog blog.naver.com/981jeju, Instagram @9.81park, app); skip the park if not confirmed
Confirm hours and that these are open 27-30 Dec: Jeongjikhan Sushi, Susuram, Cedars Sushi, Udon Kaden, Su Udon
Check snow forecast and 1100 road status; pick day 2 or 3 for outing A (swap with B if needed)
Warm hat, gloves and windproof layer for the toddler
Decide on a portable child seat or harness for short taxi rides
Download Naver Map, Kakao Map and Kakao T (K.Ride is the foreigner version); get a Korea eSIM
Buy and top up a T-money card at the airport CU or 7-Eleven on arrival
